guard: a once seat its manager does not hold after a restart is never served its task, the task's outcome says the manager does not hold it, and every pull from it is answered stop while its debt stays, across a lost answer and another restart
why: U1 forgets the stop after the first pull, so a lost answer strands the seat. U2 records no stop at
all. U3 never repeats the notice, so an idle seat never pulls, and U4 keeps repeating it after a
pull carried the stop. U5 and U6 drop the outcome's statement that the manager does not hold the
seat. U7 does not rebuild the stop from the debt after another restart.
